findings.passage: Protecting our Second Amendment rights: Strengthen Arizona's Second Amendment Firearm Freedom Act to ensure that state and local resources are not used to enforce federal gun control measures and to make that law's requirements more enforceable.
findings.note: Candidate Q&A in the Mesa Independent; answer to what bills he would introduce. Wants to tighten Arizona's law so state and local resources are not used to enforce federal gun control, and make that law easier to enforce.
subjects: state non-cooperation with federal gun control
repeal or limit of gun laws

findings.note: Same Q&A, answer on the biggest issues facing the state; lists protecting Second Amendment rights as one of six.
